PublicTemplate.description_en: The sandbox template information. It describes the ownership, runtime configuration, and current build status of a template
PublicTemplate.description_zh: 沙箱模板信息。描述一个模板的归属、运行时配置和当前构建状态

createdTime.description_en: The time when the template was created, in UTC and RFC 3339 format
createdTime.description_zh: 模板的创建时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339

name.description_en: The name of the template, which is unique within a team
name.description_zh: 模板名称，在同一团队内唯一

resourceGroupID.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the team belongs
resourceGroupID.description_zh: 团队所属的阿里云资源组 ID

runtimeConfig.description_en: The runtime configuration of the template, which determines the specifications and environment of the sandbox instances created from the template
runtimeConfig.description_zh: 模板的运行时配置，决定由该模板创建的沙箱实例的规格与环境

status.description_en: The current status of the template

teamID.description_en: The ID of the team to which the resource belongs, in UUID format
teamID.description_zh: 资源所属团队的 ID，为 UUID 格式

templateID.description_en: The ID of the sandbox template

PublicTemplateLogConfig.description_en: The log delivery configuration of the template

logstore.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service Logstore that receives sandbox runtime logs
logstore.description_zh: 接收沙箱运行日志的日志服务 Logstore 名称

project.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project that receives sandbox runtime logs
project.description_zh: 接收沙箱运行日志的日志服务 Project 名称

PublicTemplateRegistryConfig.description_en: The configuration for the template to access the image repository. For security reasons, only the network configuration is returned in queries. Logon credentials and certificate configurations are not returned
PublicTemplateRegistryConfig.description_zh: 模板访问镜像仓库的配置。出于安全考虑，查询时仅返回网络配置，不返回登录凭证和证书配置

networkConfig.description_en: The VPC configuration used to access the image repository
networkConfig.description_zh: 访问镜像仓库所使用的专有网络配置

PublicTemplateRegistryNetworkConfig.description_en: The VPC configuration used to access the image repository
PublicTemplateRegistryNetworkConfig.description_zh: 访问镜像仓库所使用的专有网络配置

securityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group used to access the image repository
securityGroupId.description_zh: 访问镜像仓库所使用的安全组 ID

vSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch used to access the image repository
vSwitchId.description_zh: 访问镜像仓库所使用的交换机 ID

vpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC used to access the image repository
vpcId.description_zh: 访问镜像仓库所使用的专有网络 VPC ID

PublicTemplateRuntimeConfig.description_en: The runtime configuration of the template

cpu.description_en: The CPU specification of the sandbox instance, in cores
cpu.description_zh: 沙箱实例的 CPU 规格，单位为核

diskSize.description_en: The disk specification of the sandbox instance, in MB
diskSize.description_zh: 沙箱实例的磁盘规格，单位为 MB

internetAccess.description_en: Specifies whether the sandbox instance is allowed to access the Internet
internetAccess.description_zh: 是否允许沙箱实例访问公网

logConfig.description_en: The log delivery configuration of the sandbox instance
logConfig.description_zh: 沙箱实例的日志投递配置

memorySize.description_en: The memory specification of the sandbox instance, in MB
memorySize.description_zh: 沙箱实例的内存规格，单位为 MB

sandboxConfig.description_en: The image and startup configuration of the sandbox instance
sandboxConfig.description_zh: 沙箱实例的镜像与启动配置

vpcConfig.description_en: The VPC configuration of the sandbox instance
vpcConfig.description_zh: 沙箱实例的专有网络配置

PublicTemplateSandboxConfig.description_en: The sandbox image and startup configuration for the template
PublicTemplateSandboxConfig.description_zh: 模板的沙箱镜像与启动配置

acrInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Container Registry Enterprise instance. This parameter is required when registryType is set to acree
acrInstanceId.description_zh: 容器镜像服务企业版实例 ID，registryType 为 acree 时必填

generation.description_en: The sandbox generation. Valid values: 1 (first generation) and 2 (second generation). Default value: 1
generation.description_zh: 沙箱代际。取值：1（第一代）或 2（第二代）。缺省为 1

image.description_en: The address of the sandbox base image

osType.description_en: The operating system type of the second-generation sandbox. Valid values: linux-amd64, android-36-osworld, and windows-osworld
osType.description_zh: 第二代沙箱的操作系统类型。取值：linux-amd64、android-36-osworld、windows-osworld

readyCommand.description_en: The readiness probe command for the sandbox. A successful execution indicates that the sandbox is ready to receive requests. This parameter is supported only by first-generation sandboxes
readyCommand.description_zh: 沙箱就绪探测命令，执行成功表示沙箱可以接收请求，仅第一代沙箱支持

registryConfig.description_en: The configuration used to access the image repository. For security reasons, only the network configuration is returned in query responses, and logon credentials are not returned
registryConfig.description_zh: 访问镜像仓库所使用的配置。出于安全考虑，查询时仅回显网络配置，不返回登录凭证

startCommand.description_en: The startup command for the sandbox container. This parameter is supported only by first-generation sandboxes
startCommand.description_zh: 沙箱容器的启动命令，仅第一代沙箱支持

steps.description_en: The list of custom build steps
steps.description_zh: 用户自定义构建步骤列表
steps.title: 用户自定义构建步骤列表

PublicTemplateStatus.description_en: The template status. Describes the current build status, failure reason, and the time when the status was reached
PublicTemplateStatus.description_zh: 模板状态。描述模板当前的构建状态、失败原因和状态到达时间

finishedAt.description_en: The time when the template reached the current desired state, in UTC and RFC 3339 format. This parameter is empty when the template is still being built or updated
finishedAt.description_zh: 模板到达当前终态的时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339。模板仍在构建或更新时为空

reason.description_en: The reason why the template entered a failure state. This parameter is returned only when state is error or updateFailed
reason.description_zh: 模板进入失败状态的原因。仅当 state 为 error 或 updateFailed 时返回

state.description_en:
The template status. Valid values:
building: The template is being built.
ready: The template is active.
updating: The template is being updated.
updateFailed: The template failed to be updated.
error: The template failed to be built
state.description_zh: 模板状态。取值：building（构建中）、ready（可用）、updating（更新中）、updateFailed（更新失败）、error（构建失败）

message.description_en: The details of the failure reason
message.example: 拉取源镜像失败：认证信息无效
message.title: 失败原因详情

step.description_en: The identity of the failed step
step.title: 失败步骤标识

args.description_en: The user build step parameter list
args.description_zh: 用户构建步骤参数列表
args.title: 用户构建步骤参数列表

type.description_en: The build instruction type, such as RUN
type.description_zh: 构建指令类型，例如 RUN
type.title: 构建指令类型，例如 RUN

PublicTemplateVPCConfig.description_en: The VPC configuration of the template

role.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by the sandbox instance when accessing the VPC. The format is acs:ram::{account ID}:role/{role name}
role.description_zh: 沙箱实例访问专有网络时扮演的 RAM 角色 ARN，格式为 acs:ram::{账号 ID}:role/{角色名}

securityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group used by the sandbox instance
securityGroupId.description_zh: 沙箱实例使用的安全组 ID

vSwitchIds.description_en: The list of vSwitch IDs to which the sandbox instance is connected
vSwitchIds.description_zh: 沙箱实例接入的交换机 ID 列表

vpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the sandbox instance is connected
vpcId.description_zh: 沙箱实例接入的专有网络 VPC ID

description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the template list with paging
name: ListTemplates

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大返回条数，默认 20，最大 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set the value to the nextToken value returned in the response of the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记，取上一页响应返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The error code. A value of 200 indicates success

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
maxResults.description_zh: 本次返回使用的每页最大条数

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This parameter is empty if no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页标记，无更多结果时为空
